description: This file defines a minimal API endpoint for creating a new catalog item in an e-commerce application. It includes route setup, request handling, validation for duplicate items, item creation, and response generation.

classes.name: CreateCatalogItemEndpoint
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint to handle the creation of catalog items, including route setup and request processing.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Establishes the POST route for creating catalog items, including authorization and endpoint configuration.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Processes the create catalog item request, checks for duplicates, creates new item, updates picture URI, and returns the response.
